# Brand & UI Language v1

Machine-readable authority: `brand_ui_language.json`. No final asset or runtime implementation is created by this specification.

## Schema Version

1

## Status

v1 production direction; implementation remains future work

## Adjectives

premium arcade; fantasy-tech; confident fighters; tactile; readable on a landscape phone

## Forbidden

generic web-dashboard card grids for every screen; Dota/Valve silhouettes, branded UI or production art copied into the game; uncontrolled neon and persistent full-screen glow; mixed generated art styles without an authored shape/material guide; microscopic text; ornament that competes with combat state

## Token Philosophy

Neutral dark surfaces carry content; gold marks brand and primary action, branch colors identify affinity and rarity accents frame acquisition value. Never rely on color alone.

## Typography


| Field | Contract / value |
| --- | --- |
| display | size_logical_px: 24; weight: 700; usage: short title or combat banner; slightly condensed with open counters |
| heading | size_logical_px: 18; weight: 700; usage: panel/card title; at most two lines |
| body | size_logical_px: 14; weight: 400; usage: effect summary and decisions |
| label | size_logical_px: 12; weight: 700; usage: secondary rarity/level labels, never sole critical instruction |
| numeric | size_logical_px: 20; weight: 700; usage: tabular timer, gold and vital values |
| font status | Family/license unresolved. System Arial used only for temporary measurement proof, not selected as shipping brand font. |

## Buttons


| Field | Contract / value |
| --- | --- |
| primary | solid warm gold, dark label, one bevel; one principal action per view |
| secondary | opaque dark surface, clear border and light label |
| disabled | reduced accent, explicit unavailable label/reason; readable text remains high contrast |
| pressed | 2 logical-pixel inset with no target movement |
| focus selected | bright outline plus check/state text; selected is independent of enabled |


## Hud


| Field | Contract / value |
| --- | --- |
| priority | fighters and authoritative combat result; health and central timer; brief skill/status cues; optional detailed statistics |
| layout | central timer above arena; health panels anchor left/right; side tables and long logs move to inspection |
| safe area | place interactive HUD inside actual platform insets; background may bleed outward |
| animation | avoid covering fighter faces, hands and impact space with banners |

## Motion


| Field | Contract / value |
| --- | --- |
| press ms | 90 |
| transition ms | 180 |
| banner ms | 350 |
| rule | Short purposeful anticipation and settle. Results follow resolver time; motion duration is presentation only. |

| effects | No strobing; prefer one impact flash, restrained particles, explicit stop lifetime. |


## Contrast Policy

Project gate: primary/secondary text >=4.5:1 against their assigned opaque surface. Accent-only graphics may be lower but cannot carry sole semantic meaning.
